suppress.notes: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces <= 3.0.3, stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns). Not applicable: braces arrives only via eslint-config-next → @next/eslint-plugin-next → fast-glob → micromatch, i.e. the lint step on CI, which expands this repository's own glob patterns. It is a devDependency, not in the standalone production image, and never sees user input. No fixed braces release exists yet (3.0.3 is latest); npm audit's "fix" is a downgrade of eslint-config-next to 14.x, which does not support Next 16. Remove this suppression when braces > 3.0.3 ships. Reviewed by: Claude (for pakornwo), 2026-10-09

GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (sprintf-js <= 1.1.3, RangeError when an attacker controls the format string's precision). Not applicable: sprintf-js arrives via @prisma/adapter-mssql → mssql → tedious, and every tedious call site passes a literal format string written in the library (e.g. 'Unrecognised data type 0x%02X', packet/login7 debug dumps) — no user-controlled format string reaches sprintf. No fixed sprintf-js release exists (1.1.3 is latest). Remove this suppression when sprintf-js > 1.1.3 ships or tedious drops it. Reviewed by: Claude (for pakornwo), 2026-10-09
